items.raw_excerpt: Sept 16 : The International Testing Agency (ITA) has completed a 1,000-km test flight in Alaska to examine whether anti-doping blood samples can withstand long journeys without being affected.The trial explored whether drones could offer an additional way of moving samples from testing sites to laboratories,
items.summary_en: The International Testing Agency finished a 1,000-km test flight in Alaska. It wanted to see if anti-doping blood samples can survive long trips by drone. The trial looked at using drones to carry samples from testing sites to laboratories.
items.summary_ko: 국제검사기구가 알래스카에서 1,000km 드론 시험 비행을 마쳤습니다. 드론으로 장거리 운송해도 도핑 혈액 검체가 영향받지 않는지 확인하려는 것이었습니다. 검사 현장에서 실험실까지 드론으로 검체를 옮기는 방안을 살펴보는 시험이었습니다.
items.title_en: Anti-doping agency tests 1,000-km drone flight in Alaska
items.title_ko: 알래스카에서 1,000km 드론 수송 시험 마친 도핑 검사기구
items.title_original: Doping-ITA completes 1,000-km drone test in Alaska

items.raw_excerpt: A woman who borrowed $30,000 to buy a boat to live on in 2024 wasn't expecting it to turn into a $18,000 overdraft and an ongoing battle with her bank.
items.summary_en: A woman borrowed $30,000 in 2024 to buy a boat and live on it. The loan became an $18,000 overdraft and a long fight with her bank. Repayments took up to 99 percent of her income, and her boat dream sank.
items.summary_ko: 한 여성이 2024년 배 한 척을 사서 그 위에서 살기 위해 3만 달러를 빌렸습니다. 그 대출은 1만 8천 달러의 마이너스 통장과 은행과의 오랜 다툼으로 이어졌습니다. 월급의 99퍼센트를 갚는 데 써야 할 만큼 빠듯했고, 결국 배 위에서 살겠다는 꿈은 가라앉았습니다.
items.title_en: Woman's dream of living on a boat ends after loan battle with bank
items.title_ko: 배에서 살겠다던 꿈, 은행과의 싸움 끝에 무너지다
items.title_original: 'Repayments reached 99% of my income': Battling bank over a loan sinks woman's boat dream

items.raw_excerpt: There is a 'limited need' for more housing 'because we're 20 minutes from anything', with existing new houses not selling. But councillors were also told 'every single (Cornish) village in my view for the future is likely to have more housing'.
items.summary_en: Local people in Cornwall said their prayers were answered when a church's unpopular housing plan was rejected. Councillors said there is only a limited need for more housing because the village is 20 minutes from anything. Still, they expect most Cornish villages will grow in the future.
items.summary_ko: 콘월의 한 마을 주민들은 교회가 추진한 인기 없는 주택 건설 계획이 무산되자 기도가 응답받았다고 말했다. 의원들은 마을이 무엇이든 20분 거리에 있어 새 주택 수요가 제한적이라며, 기존에 지어진 신축 주택도 팔리지 않고 있다고 전했다. 그럼에도 미래에는 콘월의 거의 모든 마을에 주택이 더 늘어날 것이라고 전망했다.
items.title_en: Villagers win bid to stop church housing plan
items.title_ko: 콘월 주민, 교회 주택 계획 저지에 환호
items.title_original: Cornwall planning: Residents' prayers are answered over church's unpopular housing bid - Cornwall Live

items.raw_excerpt: About 60 years ago, an oil and gas survey found unusual reefs off the South Australian coastline. Now, a geologist wants to know whether it is evidence of a volcano.
items.summary_en: About 60 years ago, a survey found strange reefs off the South Australian coast. A geologist now wants to find out if these reefs are evidence of an underwater volcano.
items.summary_ko: 약 60년 전, 남호주 앞바다에서 이상한 암초가 발견됐다. 한 지질학자가 이 암초가 해저 화산의 증거인지 알아보려 하고 있다.
items.title_en: Geologist hunts for underwater volcano off South Australia
items.title_ko: 지질학자, 남호주 앞바다 해저 화산 증거 찾아 나서
items.title_original: Geologist hopes to find evidence of underwater volcano
